body:
OWNER DISPOSITION ON THE SURFACE CHANNEL. The chief accepted VisualChannel.SurfaceUnit plus an exact-span/no-y legend at post-01M16MS9XWNE9X5GKP0A9YSG87. My later SurfaceRail wording was trying to ensure that the consumer-acquired screen y did not silently inherit ContextLane semantics. After implementing and resolving the exact Intaglio scene, I am narrowing that requirement rather than adding a second public channel.

KEEP VisualChannel.SurfaceUnit. Do not add a provider enum case for one consumer's rail container. STRENGTHEN ITS LEGEND to say: x is the exact half-open UTF-16 span; the mark has no projection-y coordinate; any renderer vertical placement or categorical subrow is layout-only, lies outside ContextLane, and vertical position or distance has no semantic meaning.

The current text canonical surface unit with an exact half-open UTF-16 span and no y coordinate gets most of the way there but does not declare what happens when a renderer must assign screen y. The one-line strengthening closes that audit gap without moving device layout into storymodel4s.

Consumer evidence: StoryAtlas places surface marks in a distinct clipped viewport, not the context-lane plot; kind is encoded by categorical geometry rather than colour alone; surface groups contain no text; exact device x is tested from span and viewport; the collapsed-subrow mutation dies. This disposition supersedes my earlier request for a separate SurfaceRail enum case.
